'''Squik''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was part of a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] smuggling deal with a [[Unidentified thug boss|thug boss]]. The boss requested two dozen cases of spice, but Squik only had two cases of the drug when the two met at a warehouse on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[3951 BBY]]. 

==Biography==
In [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Dark Wars]],<ref name="CAMP">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Squik was part of<ref name="KOTOR II" /> a smuggling deal concerning the drug [[Spice/Legends|spice]]<ref name="Prima">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide]]''</ref> with a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Unidentified thug boss|thug boss]]. The Trandoshan had ordered two dozen cases<ref name="KOTOR II" /> of spice<ref name="Prima" /> though Squik only procured two cases.<ref name="KOTOR II" /> At a warehouse<ref name="Prima" /> in the [[Refugee Sector]] of the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the Twi'lek met with the Trandoshan and three other [[Alien/Legends|alien]] thugs.<ref name="KOTOR II" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
[[File:SquikDeal-KOTOR2.png|thumb|right|300px|Squik dealt with the thug boss at a Nar Shaddaa warehouse.]]
While the deal took place, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|Exile]]<ref name="KOTOR II" /> [[Meetra Surik]]<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> entered while on the [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (First Jedi Purge)|search]] for the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Zez-Kai Ell]]. After<ref name="KOTOR II" /> her<ref name="Revan" /> entrance, Squik told the thug boss that his order was complete, only for the Trandoshan to inform them they wanted two dozen cases and questioned what they could do with only two.<ref name="KOTOR II" />

While Squik changed the subject to payment, a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] thug noticed Surik inside the warehouse. Thinking the Twi'lek had staged an ambush, the Trandoshan told Squik the Twi'lek's "double-crossing" [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] would adorn their wall. After the thug boss remotely closed and locked the doors to the warehouse, Squik entered into a fighting stance, but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the thug boss before they could fight back. Surik was able to kill the Trandoshan and their thug companions.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Squik, a [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] Twi'lek, had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and skin. The Trandoshan thug boss believed the Twi'lek to be a double-crosser when Surik entered the warehouse.<ref name="KOTOR II" />

==Equipment==
While on Nar Shaddaa, Squik wore a tan [[Color/Legends|shirt]], tan pants, and a pair of brown boots. He also wore a brown belt with one pouch and brown gloves. His spice was kept in gray metal cases.<ref name="KOTOR II" />

==Behind the scenes==
Squik first appeared in the [[2004]] [[Obsidian Entertainment]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''. The encounter with Squik at the warehouse is optional and not required for game completion.<ref name="KOTOR II" /> This article assumes the encounter did happen, with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.
